description.p2: This beautiful 45m² fully renovated apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 5-story building with elevator. Completely refurbished, it combines comfort, modernity and an exceptional location.

faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know before your stay at Appartement du Port.
faq.moreQuestionsText: Feel free to contact us, we will respond as soon as possible.

items.question: How do I book?
items.answer: Select your dates, fill in the form and pay online by credit card. You will receive a confirmation email immediately.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Credit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via Stripe, a 100% secure platform.

items.question: Can I cancel my booking?
items.answer: Free cancellation up to 30 days before arrival. Between 30 and 14 days: 50% refund. Less than 14 days: non-refundable.

items.question: What is the 300€ security deposit?
items.answer: A hold of 300€ is placed on your card at the time of payment. It is not charged. It is released within 7 days after your departure if no damage is found.

items.question: What is the apartment's capacity?
items.answer: Maximum 4 people. The apartment has a bedroom with a flexible bed (1 queen 160×200 or 2 singles 80×200) and a sofa bed in the living room.

items.question: Is there air conditioning?
items.answer: Yes, in the living room and bedroom.

items.question: Is parking included?
items.answer: Yes, a secure private parking space is included, 50m from the building.

items.question: Is Wi-Fi available?
items.answer: Yes, high-speed internet included.

items.question: Is there an elevator?
items.answer: Yes, 3rd floor with elevator.

items.question: What are the check-in/check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in between 3pm and 5pm. Check-out before 10am.

items.question: How do I access the apartment?
items.answer: Detailed access information (code, floor, parking) will be sent to you by email 48 hours before your arrival.

items.question: Where do I park?
items.answer: Private parking is included. The exact location will be communicated before your arrival.

items.question: Are pets allowed?
items.answer: No, pets are not allowed regardless of their size.

items.question: Is smoking allowed?
items.answer: No, the apartment is strictly non-smoking. Deodorizing fees (minimum 500€) will be charged if not respected.

items.question: Are there quiet hours?
items.answer: Yes, quiet hours are from 10pm to 9am.

items.question: Are parties allowed?
items.answer: No, parties, events and undeclared visitors are prohibited.

items.question: How do I get to Porquerolles?
items.answer: Ferries depart from the port (100m from the apartment) throughout the day for Port-Cros and Le Levant, with only 2 departures and 2 returns in July and August for Porquerolles. Crossing ~20 min. Book in advance during peak season at tlv-tvm.com.

items.question: Where are the nearest beaches?
items.answer: Bona beach is 500m on foot.

items.question: Are there shops nearby?
items.answer: Yes, restaurants and shops are 20m away (on the port). Hyères city center is 5.6km away.

items.question: How do I get from the airport?
items.answer: Toulon-Hyères airport is only 1.5km away. Bus line 63, stop Jean d'Agrève, is 20 meters from the building entrance.
